verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Public API doc, which says organizations can manage members, collections, groups, event logs, and policies. That establishes some org-level policy management, but nothing describes which policies exist or how they are enforced on member apps. Missing for 10: evidence of an enforced app-lock/vault-timeout policy, an export-restriction policy, master-password strength requirements, admin-console policy enforcement across clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
